title: Rust permits concurrent indistinguishable T=0 fragmentation senders
description: FragmentationPolicy tracks only peer generation/counter/version and FragmentSender::new consumes no active-session reservation. Multiple senders for the same authenticated local identity, remote signer, direction, and Rule 0x78 can be constructed and started simultaneously; with T=0 their interleaved fragments are indistinguishable. Add bounded atomic session reservation/release keyed by local/remote/direction/rule, terminal hold-down, cancellation/drop behavior, and concurrent construction/start tests.
